title: solution
description: Note Single-valued navigation properties (bind with <name>@odata.bind, expand with $expand): configurationpageid, createdby, createdonbehalfby, fileid, modifiedby, modifiedonbehalfby, organizationid, parentsolutionid, publisherid.

createdon.description: Date and time when the solution was created.

enabledforsourcecontrolintegration.description: Indicates if solution is enabled for source control integration

friendlyname.description: User display name for the solution.

installedon.description: Date and time when the solution was installed/upgraded.

isapimanaged.description: Information about whether the solution is api managed.

ismanaged.description: Indicates whether the solution is managed or unmanaged.

isvisible.description: Indicates whether the solution is visible outside of the platform.

modifiedon.description: Date and time when the solution was last modified.

pinpointpublisherid.description: Identifier of the publisher of this solution in Microsoft Pinpoint.

pinpointsolutiondefaultlocale.description: Default locale of the solution in Microsoft Pinpoint.

pinpointsolutionid.description: Identifier of the solution in Microsoft Pinpoint.

sourcecontrolsyncstatus.description: Indicates the current status of source control integration

templatesuffix.description: The template suffix of this solution

uniquename.description: The unique name of this solution

updatedon.description: Date and time when the solution was updated.

upgradeinfo.description: Contains component info for the solution upgrade operation

version.description: Solution version, used to identify a solution for upgrades and hotfixes.

_configurationpageid_value.description: A link to an optional configuration page for this solution.

_createdby_value.description: Unique identifier of the user who created the solution.

_createdonbehalfby_value.description: Unique identifier of the delegate user who created the solution.

_modifiedby_value.description: Unique identifier of the user who last modified the solution.

_modifiedonbehalfby_value.description: Unique identifier of the delegate user who modified the solution.

_organizationid_value.description: Unique identifier of the organization associated with the solution.

_parentsolutionid_value.description: Unique identifier of the parent solution.
